text: Follow the light
When the map has lost its lines
And the road forgets its signs
There's a compass in my chest
Pointing me above the rest
Through the noise and through the dark
I can see my spark
North star, shining in me
Exactly where I'm meant to be
No storm can steal my glow
I light the way I go
North star, follow me
Every wrong turn taught me right
Every blackout taught me light
Now I navigate by fire
Higher, higher, higher
